newsitem.title: ITALY: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Wednesday December 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Wednesday December 11.

text.p: The following are some of the top headlines in leading Italian newspapers.
* President Oscar Luigi Scalfaro told lower house and upper house speakers Luciano Violante and Nicola Mancino at a meeting there should be no amnesties for those involved in bribery scandals (all).
* The centre-right opposition and the centre-left ruling coalition reach an agreement over extending television licences (all).
* Former minister and ex-magistrate Antonio Di Pietro says his documents will show he had no relation to banker Pierfrancesco Pacini Battaglia, recently jailed in a corruption probe (all).
* Italian state holding IRI takes direct control of motorway operator Autostrade removing it from the books of Fintecna, subsidiary of state holding Iri. (Sole 24 Ore).
* September figures for industrial orders gloomy, showing a fall of 2.4 percent year on year (Sole 24 Ore).
* Finance minister Vincenzo Visco says self-assessed taxation will provide higher revenue than previously expected (Sole 24 Ore).
Reuters has not verified these stories and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
